basic_info.description: Live in NOPA at the Heart of the City at 1608 Fulton Street in a spacious, house-like condominium. This top floor home features south-facing bay windows with a view of Sutro Tower, updated lighting, gorgeous gas fireplace and a classic wood paneled dining room with built-in buffet. Three generous bedrooms and a split bath with clawfoot tub provides lots of  flexibility. For the home cook, the kitchen is spacious with extra storage in a walk-in pantry and in the adjacent laundry room with full sized appliances. Out the back door, the recently replaced deck and staircase lead to the beautifully manicured, shared garden. An additional plus is your deeded, independent parking space and storage area.   The neighborhood is amazing! Stroll to classic San Francisco establishments like The Mill, Bi-Rite, and NOPA Restaurant in minutes! Centrally located just three blocks to the wonders of Golden Gate Park and four blocks to Alamo Square Park, allowing you to live out a true San Francisco dream in this 1904 gem.
